consumer: The engine's dialogue/condition possession check (set_has_items lambda) asking 'does the avatar actor hold >= 30 of 9mm on person?' as an evaluated yes/no.
scope: only the character's own carried items (wielded/worn/inventory) on person
decisive_source: src/condition.cpp::conditional_t<T>::set_has_items — its body returns actor->has_charges(item_id,count) || actor->has_amount(item_id,count), an engine-computed boolean over the character actor that sums both charge-based and discrete counts.
divergence: 30 rounds of 9mm stored inside a worn ammo container/magazine (charges, not loose top-level items): a count that reads only loose '9mm' entries in carried_items[] reports false, while the engine predicate (has_charges||has_amount) returns true.
